description: This file is a shell script used for testing and automating tasks involving cloning a Git repository, mapping users, and interacting with Perforce depot, including starting processes and creating repositories.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up the depot client view mapping in Perforce.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to Perforce version control.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to Perforce repository with a description.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Configures Git settings, especially user mappings.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository using git-p4.

methods.name: git log
methods.description: Outputs commit logs, formatted for extracting author info.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the expected and actual output during tests.
